extraMeanings.en: given or provided by someone (courtesy of)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The photo is reproduced here courtesy of the National Gallery.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Fotoğraf burada Ulusal Galeri'nin izniyle yeniden basılmıştır.

extraMeanings.en: the amount of protection given by an insurance policy
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Does your policy provide coverage for dental treatment?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Poliçen diş tedavisi için teminat sağlıyor mu?

extraMeanings.en: the area reached by a signal or service
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There's no mobile phone coverage in the mountains.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dağlarda cep telefonu kapsama alanı yok.

extraMeanings.en: an bad-tempered person who complains a lot
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Don't be such a crab, we're only ten minutes late.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar huysuz olma, sadece on dakika geç kaldık.

extraMeanings.en: to break or cause to break without fully separating
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She cracked an egg into the bowl.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yumurtayı kaseye kırdı.

extraMeanings.en: a narrow opening or gap
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He peered through the crack in the door.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kapının aralığından dikizledi.

extraMeanings.en: to move very slowly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The traffic was crawling along the motorway.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Trafik otoyolda çok yavaş ilerliyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to be full of something unpleasant (be crawling with)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The old cellar was crawling with insects.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Eski bodrum böceklerle kaynıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to make lines or folds in cloth or paper
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Try not to crease your shirt before the meeting.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan önce gömleğini buruşturmamaya çalış.

extraMeanings.en: qualities or experience that make someone suitable
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She has excellent credentials for the teaching job.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenlik işi için mükemmel niteliklere sahip.

extraMeanings.en: a design used as an emblem of a family or organization
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The players wore shirts with the club crest on them.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Oyuncular üzerinde kulüp arması olan formalar giydi.

extraMeanings.en: the top of a wave
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The surfer rode the crest of the wave.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sörfçü dalganın tepesinde ilerledi.

extraMeanings.en: a group of people who spend time together
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He went to the party with his usual crew.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Partiye her zamanki takımıyla gitti.

extraMeanings.en: unrefined petroleum
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The price of crude rose sharply this week.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ham petrol fiyatı bu hafta keskin şekilde yükseldi.

extraMeanings.en: the result of multiplying a number by itself twice
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cube of 3 is 27.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: 3'ün küpü 27'dir.

extraMeanings.en: a long stick used to hit the ball in billiards or snooker
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He chalked his cue before taking the shot.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Vuruştan önce istekasına tebeşir sürdü.

extraMeanings.en: to give someone a signal to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The director cued the actor to enter the stage.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yönetmen oyuncuya sahneye girmesi için işaret verdi.

extraMeanings.en: handcuffs; to put handcuffs on someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The police cuffed the suspect and led him away.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Polis şüpheliye kelepçe taktı ve onu götürdü.

extraMeanings.en: the cause of a problem
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A faulty wire was the culprit behind the fire.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yangının sorumlusu arızalı bir kabloydu.

extraMeanings.en: to form or twist into a curved shape
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cat curled up in front of the fire.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kedi ateşin önünde kıvrılıp yattı.

extraMeanings.en: to go somewhere quickly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I have to dash or I'll miss the train.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Fırlamam lazım yoksa treni kaçıracağım.

extraMeanings.en: the beginning of a period or event
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We are living at the dawn of a new era.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni bir çağın başlangıcında yaşıyoruz.

extraMeanings.tr: aklına yatmak, kafasına dank etmek (dawn on)
extraMeanings.en: to become suddenly clear to someone (dawn on)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It finally dawned on me that she had lied.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sonunda onun yalan söylediği kafama dank etti.

extraMeanings.en: a set of playing cards
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She shuffled the deck and dealt the cards.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Desteyi karıştırdı ve kağıtları dağıttı.

extraMeanings.en: a floor or level, especially of a bus
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We sat on the top deck of the bus.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Otobüsün üst katına oturduk.

extraMeanings.en: to win against someone in a contest or war
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Our team defeated the champions in the final.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Takımımız finalde şampiyonları yendi.

extraMeanings.en: to prevent something from succeeding
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The purpose of the law is defeated by such loopholes.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kanunun amacı böyle açıklarla boşa çıkıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to leave a country or group to join an opposing one
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The spy defected to the West during the Cold War.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Casus Soğuk Savaş sırasında Batı'ya iltica etti.

extraMeanings.en: to think about or discuss something carefully
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The jury deliberated for three days before reaching a verdict.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Jüri karara varmadan önce üç gün müzakere etti.

extraMeanings.en: stupid or slow to understand
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Am I being dense, or does this make no sense?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ben mi kalın kafalıyım, yoksa bu gerçekten anlamsız mı?

extraMeanings.en: an elected member of parliament in some countries
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The deputies voted in favour of the new law.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Milletvekilleri yeni yasa lehinde oy kullandı.

extraMeanings.en: to be related to someone who lived long ago
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She claims to be descended from a royal family.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir kraliyet ailesinin soyundan geldiğini iddia ediyor.

extraMeanings.en: to arrive and affect a place (silence, darkness)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A strange silence descended on the room.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Odaya tuhaf bir sessizlik çöktü.

extraMeanings.en: slowly and carefully
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He spoke slowly and deliberately so everyone could understand.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Herkesin anlayabilmesi için yavaş ve ölçülü konuştu.
